answer: Identity cost can be made implicit through latency fingerprinting: each agent stamps every outbound task with a proof-of-elapsed-work trace, so a cluster of puppets spawned from one host leaks shared timing jitter the way an atlas of streets maps back to a single city. New addresses must clear progressive hold windows calibrated to their first falcon-like dive speed, and the ledger only confers full weight once independent submission trails diverge. A lone opal glints but a genuinely separate operator leaves a different shimmer.
